checks.reason: mono_source_budget destructures the supplied PhysicalKSBoxFactorialData witness as F,h0,hreg,hY,hT,hbound and reconstructs the conclusion with exactly F,h0,hreg,hY,hT. For each profile order r it also retains (hbound r).1, the existing finite weighted MemLp assertion. Only the numerical inequality (hbound r).2 is enlarged by transitivity. Thus the underlying function f, center t0, M,A, derivative family, order-by-order local squared budgets, weak identities and profile-domain finiteness are all retained.

commonKSBoxFactorialConstant_one_le proves C(M)>=1 for every real M by comparing the c=1 fixed constant to the maximum. The lemma obtains C(M)>=0 and A>=0 from hA. For fixed r, the profile factor 12*C*A*(3072*C*A)^r*r! is therefore nonnegative. The source inequalities F0<=F1 and W0<=W1 imply F0+498*sqrt(W0)<=F1+498*sqrt(W1), using monotonicity of real sqrt. Multiplication by the unchanged nonnegative factors proves the target. No change of M or A or illicit monotonicity of a negative factor occurs.
checks.scope_note: The retained physical-domain hypotheses 1<=M, 0<=F0 and 0<=W0 are stronger than the algebra needs; their unused-variable warnings are harmless. F1,W1 are nonnegative whenever the displayed lower-budget hypotheses hold. The theorem does not assert monotonicity in M or A.

checks.reason: For any finite index type and supplied i, norm(z_i)^2 is at most the sum of nonnegative norm(z_j)^2. Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le turns that exact square comparison into norm(z_i)<=sqrt(sum norm(z_j)^2). This is the usual finite Euclidean component domination, with no missing cardinality factor. The supplied i suffices even though the general theorem does not assume the index type is nonempty.

spinOriginFactorialSourceBudget(M,u) is literally M*sqrt(sum_sigma norm(u_sigma(0))^2)*sqrt(V), with the same fixed physicalKSUniformSourceVolume V used by the scalar endpoint. For M>=0 its nonnegativity follows from nonnegative square roots. The component source factor M*norm(u_sigma(0))*sqrt(V) is bounded by it by two multiplications of the finite component-norm inequality by nonnegative factors. Neither the origin amplitude nor the volume factor is incorrectly squared or omitted.

The consumed definition is spinOriginH12Budget(C_H,L,u)=(L^2+sum_sigma norm(u_sigma(0))^2)*C_H. Each component has (L^2+norm(u_sigma(0))^2)*C_H. The proof adds the same L^2 to the nonnegative single-term/sum comparison, then multiplies by C_H>=0. In the reviewed final PASS source the addition is explicitly add_le_add le_rfl hi, matching the stated summand order.
checks.scope_note: This is a common upper bound for each component. It is not a bound on the sum of all components H12 budgets; the latter would in general contain multiple L^2 contributions. No aggregate spin-profile bound is asserted in these files.
